item.title: Idaho native wins Team USA’s first gold of the 2026 Olympic Games
item.description: VICTOR, Teton County (Idaho Statesman) – Idaho native Breezy Johnson won Team USA’s first gold of the 2026 Olympic Games on Sunday in Cortina d’Ampezzo, Italy. Born in Victor, Idaho, Johnson claimed the women’s downhill with a time of 1 minute, 36.1 seconds to best silver medalist Emma Aicher of Germany by .04 seconds.
